edition.notes: A dated delivery state of a public-domain nineteenth-century translation. The delivery preserves the printed volume's footnote numbering and its printed page markers, including the editors' report of the marginal note in one of Krabinger's codices at chapter XXVI warning that the passage savours of Origen's opinion. The printed volume itself was not acquired or collated here.

work.author: Gregory of Nyssa
work.description: Gregory of Nyssa's late fourth-century handbook for catechists, in a prologue and forty chapters, addressed by chapter number. Chapter numbering differs between editions and translations; a consumer citing a chapter should name the edition. Several chapters, notably the twenty-sixth, state a restoration of all things extending to the author of evil himself, and Greek manuscripts of the work carry marginal warnings to that effect.
work.title: Oratio catechetica magna
